Reproduced with the loader's own command (`Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Compress`, open-brain/src/shared/process-session.ts:206): raw 0x1A (SUB) at two offsets, in the command lines of two bash.exe processes under ANOTHER session's claude.exe (a running Bash tool command; 0x1A is most likely a character Windows could not map). Callers that fail closed while such a process exists: liveOwnerProbe (suite-owner.ts:147: every test:heavy on the machine) and resolveCursorAgentHost (process-session.ts:278: the SessionStart proof of Cursor seats). Fix (deterministic): in the table parser (process-session.ts ~:154-160), replace every raw U+0000-U+001F in the payload with a space (or a \u00XX escape) before JSON.parse; a row whose command line held one still matches claude.exe / cursor-agent patterns. Test with a payload holding raw 0x1A, 0x07 and 0x1B inside a CommandLine string. Then retry T-268's live check. — — s169: brief docs/loops/t270-table-control-chars-brief.md merged as docs PR #674 (7a993a39); launch line sent to clark for the QA PC (base ff9492d6). Its step 4 reproduces the failure live with one sleeper process whose command line holds a raw 0x1A. — s170 CLOSED. READY 03ebed68 PR #677 (QA PC one-off; its step 4 NOT REPRODUCED, see below); planner ACCEPT; merged c1975286 (refreshed 461bbcb6, patch-id = the reviewed head; trees equal; Aaron 19:47:42Z 'merge SIA #677', relay-check verified); main rebuilt c1975286. ROOT CAUSE CORRECTED, first-hand on the desktop: ConvertTo-Json escapes control characters (\u001a) on BOTH PCs (PS 5.1.19041.6456, CLR 4.0.30319.42000). The raw C0 bytes are made on the PowerShell-to-Node pipe by the console's OEM cp437 best-fit encoder: → 0x1A, ← 0x1B, ↑ 0x18, ↓ 0x19, ↔ 0x1D, • 0x07, § 0x15, ¶ 0x14, ☺ 0x01, ► 0x10 (other non-ASCII: U+FFFD or a best-fit ASCII). So any process whose command line held an arrow or a bullet broke the table on every Windows host, and the brief's raw-0x1A sleeper could never reproduce (the brief now carries a Correction section). LIVE CHECK PASS (main build c1975286, desktop): a payload built inside PowerShell with [char]0x2192 arrives with a raw 0x1A and parses (2 rows, ppid kept); the live table loads (561 rows). The reply's mutant section was lost to grep's binary detection; M1 = the pasted red run, M2 and M3 are red by construction (C2 and C8 read). Follow-up: T-279.
